name: Exploration
summary: The exploration chart for the ruined Dwarf stronghold of Karak Azgal. Exploration and income follow the rulebook; wyrdstone is treasure.
income_note: Wherever the rules say wyrdstone, read treasure.

places.name: Well
places.rules: Choose a Hero and roll a D6. If the result is equal to or lower than his Toughness he finds one piece of treasure at the bottom of the well. If he fails he swallows tainted water and misses the next game through sickness.

places.name: Ransacked Storeroom
places.rules: You find loot worth D6 gc. If you roll a 1 you also find a Lucky Charm.

places.name: Corpse
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find on the body:
1-2 D6 gc
3 Dagger
4 Axe
5 Sword
6 Suit of light armour

places.name: Straggler
places.rules:
A survivor of Karak Azgal, lost in the tunnels.
Skaven warbands can sell him to Clan Mors for 2D6 gc.
Possessed, Beastman or greenskin warbands can sacrifice him and the warband leader gains +1 Experience.
Undead warbands can kill him and gain a Zombie at no cost.
Any other warband can interrogate him: next time you roll on the exploration chart, roll one more dice than usual and discard any one dice (with three Heroes, roll four dice and pick any three).

places.name: Overturned Cart
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 Karak Azgal map
3-4 A purse with 2D6 gc
5-6 A jewelled sword and dagger, which can be kept or sold at twice the value of a normal sword and dagger. The usual selling price is half the actual cost, so the jewelled sword sells for 10 gc.

places.name: Ruined Store Sheds
places.rules: You find loot worth D6 gc amongst the ruins.

places.name: Drinking Hall
places.rules: Full barrels remain in an alcove at the back of the hall. The warband's leader must take a Leadership test, with a -1 Leadership penalty for Dwarfs. If he passes, the warband gains 4D6 gc worth of Dwarf ale, which can be sold immediately. If he fails, the warriors drink most of it and only D6 gc worth of ale is left when the warband reaches its encampment. Undead, Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and any other religious order pass the test automatically.

places.name: Workshop
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 Sword
2 Double-handed weapon
3 Dwarf axe
4 D3 halberds
5 Gromril sword
6 2D6 gc worth of metal, added to the treasury

places.name: Prisoners
places.rules:
A group of prisoners taken by Skaven to be used as slaves.
Possessed, Beastman and greenskin warbands can sacrifice them and gain D3 Experience, distributed amongst the Heroes.
Undead warbands can kill them and gain D3 Zombies at no cost.
Skaven can sell them into slavery for 3D6 gc.
Any other warband can escort them to safety and is rewarded with 2D6 gc. In addition one prisoner of the same race as the warband asks to join: if you can afford to equip him, add a new Henchman to any Henchman group with the same characteristics as the rest of the group, even if they have already gained experience.

places.name: Goblin Stash
places.rules:
A Goblin stash of missile weapons. Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 D3 short bows
3 D3 bows
4 Long bows
5 Quiver of hunting arrows
6 D3 crossbows

places.name: Market
places.rules: You find several items worth 2D6 gc in total.

places.name: Repaying a Debt
places.rules: An old Dwarf acquaintance repays a debt. You gain the services of any one Hired Sword available to your warband for the next battle, free of charge. After the battle he departs, or you may keep paying his upkeep as normal.

places.name: Gunsmith
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 Blunderbuss
2 Brace of pistols
3 Brace of duelling pistols
4 D3 handguns
5 D3 flasks of superior blackpowder
6 Hochland long rifle

places.name: Shrine of Valaya
places.rules:
A ruined shrine to the Dwarf goddess Valaya. The warband may strip the shrine and gain 3D6 gc worth of loot.
A Dwarf warband may instead save the shrine's holy relics: it gains 3D6 gc from the Dwarf colony, and one of its weapons (chosen by the player) is blessed by Valaya and always wounds magic users on a to wound roll of 2+.

places.name: Meeting Room
places.rules: Your warband finds 3D6 gc worth of loot.

places.name: Armourer
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 D3 shields
3 D3 helmets
4 D3 suits of light armour
5 D3 suits of heavy armour
6 Suit of Gromril armour

places.name: Mausoleum
places.rules:
Any warband apart from Dwarfs, Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar or any other warband with a priest may loot the crypts and gains D6x10 gc worth of loot. If you loot the mausoleum, Dwarfs bear a grudge and hate every model in your warband every time you play them, and the next time you play Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar or any other warband with a priest the entire enemy warband hates every model in your warband for that game. Note it on your roster.
Dwarfs, Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar or any other warband with a priest may instead seal the graves and are rewarded with D6 Experience distributed amongst the Heroes.

places.name: Secret Tunnels
places.rules: You may use the tunnels in the next battle you play. Position up to three fighters (not Rat Ogres, Possessed or large models) anywhere on the battlefield at ground level. They are set up at the end of the player's first turn and cannot be placed within 8" of any enemy model. Dwarf miners already know the tunnels and gain no advantage, but may stop an opponent using them.

places.name: Strongroom
places.rules: Hidden amongst the debris you find D6x10 gc to add to your treasury.

places.name: Engineers Office
places.rules: You find loot worth 3D6 gc and a battered notebook. One of your Heroes may study the engineer's notebook: he may choose from Academic skills whenever he gains a new skill, in addition to the skill lists normally open to him.

places.name: Jewelsmith
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 Quartz stones worth D6x5 gc
3-4 Amethyst worth 20 gc
5 Necklace worth 50 gc
6 A ruby worth D6x15 gc

places.name: Guild Office
places.rules: Inside you find regalia that can be sold for 2D6x5 gc. If you roll a double you instead find the symbol of the Order of Freetraders: a Hero who holds it gains the Haggle skill.

places.name: Boiler Room
places.rules: You find D3 items of treasure amongst the ruins. In addition take a Leadership test against the warband leader's Leadership. If it is passed, a wardog that was hiding in the room joins the warband.

places.name: Entrance to Secret Tunnels
places.rules: From now on you may re-roll one dice when you roll on the exploration chart. Note it on your roster. Second and further entrances grant no more re-rolls, although you may find further re-rolls from other sources.

places.name: The Lair
places.rules: The lair of one of the creatures that still inhabit the lower levels. If you wish, send one of your Heroes in to search for treasure and roll a D6. On a 1 the Hero is devoured and never seen again. On a 2 or more he returns with D6+1 items of treasure.

places.name: Hidden Treasure
places.rules:
A hidden chest bearing the runes of a Dwarf Noble's clan. Roll a D6 for each item on the list separately, apart from the gold crowns, to see whether you find it:
D3 items of treasure 4+
5D6x5 gc Auto
Holy relic 5+
Suit of heavy armour 5+
D3 gems worth 10 gc each 4+
Holy tome 5+
Runic artefact 4+

places.name: Dwarf Smithy
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 D3 double-handed axes
2 D3 suits of heavy armour
3 Gromril axe
4 Gromril hammer
5 Double-handed gromril axe
6 Gromril armour

places.name: Slaughtered Warband
places.rules:
Roll a D6 for each item on the list separately, apart from the gold crowns and daggers, to see whether you find it:
3D6x5 gc Auto
D3 suits of light armour 4+
Suit of heavy armour 5+
D6 daggers Auto
Karak Azgal map 4+
D3 halberds 5+
D3 swords 3+
D3 shields 2+
D3 bows 4+
D3 helmets 2+

places.name: Warrior Training Ground
places.rules: You find a training manual, which can be sold for 100 gc or read by one of your Heroes. A Hero who reads it may choose from Combat skills whenever he gains a new skill, and his Weapon Skill may be increased by one point above his racial maximum (a Human who has read it could reach Weapon Skill 7).

places.name: Nobles Dwelling
places.rules: Roll a D6. On a 1-2 you find D6x10 gc worth of items and money to add to your treasury. On a 3-4 you find D6 vials of Crimson Shade. On a 5-6 you find a hidden magical artefact: roll on the Karak Azgal Runic Artefacts table.
